subject.title: skill_workshop apply times out ("Approval timed out") on large proposals (~28KB)

question: Should OpenClaw resolve this cluster by adopting the broader bounded-approval behavior in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100498, or by landing a narrower timeout-only fix?
rationale: The source-repro is clear, but the durable fix defines how long security-sensitive Skill Workshop lifecycle approvals may wait, what the operator sees, and how agents should recover after expiry; that is maintainer policy, not a mechanical cleanup choice.

options.title: Adopt the bounded lifecycle approval fix
options.body: Prefer https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100498 or an equivalent patch that fits inside the Codex watchdog, enriches approval context, and returns an actionable pending-state result.

options.title: Land a narrow watchdog alignment
options.body: Use a smaller timeout-only patch such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/91325 only if maintainers want to preserve the current approval UI and semantics for now.

options.title: Reject timeout expansion
options.body: Keep the current security boundary and document CLI/manual approval recovery, accepting that agent-tool apply remains fragile under default pending approval.

recommendation.title: Adopt the bounded lifecycle approval fix
recommendation.body: Prefer https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100498 or an equivalent patch that fits inside the Codex watchdog, enriches approval context, and returns an actionable pending-state result.

likelyOwner.reason: `steipete` is assigned to the issue and authored the broader open PR that closes this issue and the adjacent approval-detail/time-budget reports.
